q: Which Schedule of the Constitution has the anti-defection law?
x: The 10th Schedule was added by the 52nd Amendment in 1985. It disqualifies a member who leaves the party they were elected from.

q: The 6th Schedule covers tribal areas of which four states?
x: 6th Schedule = autonomous district councils in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram. Tribal areas of other states fall under the 5th Schedule.

q: Who called the Preamble the "identity card of the Constitution"?
x: N.A. Palkhivala used this phrase. K.M. Munshi called the Preamble the "horoscope" of the Constitution.

q: Which Article gives the right to go to the Supreme Court to protect Fundamental Rights?
x: Article 32 (constitutional remedies). Ambedkar called it the heart and soul of the Constitution. Article 226 is the High Court's writ power.

q: Who presides over a joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament?
x: The President calls the joint sitting (Article 108), but the Lok Sabha Speaker presides over it.

q: Within how many days must the Rajya Sabha return a Money Bill?
x: The Rajya Sabha can only suggest changes and must return a Money Bill in 14 days; after that it is deemed passed.

q: Which amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18?
x: The 61st Amendment (1988, in force 1989) changed Article 326 to make the voting age 18.

q: Which committee recommended adding Fundamental Duties?
x: The Swaran Singh Committee (1976). The duties were added by the 42nd Amendment as Article 51A.

q: Which Article mentions a Uniform Civil Code?
x: Article 44 is a Directive Principle asking the State to try to secure a Uniform Civil Code. Article 40 is village panchayats.

q: Members of a State Public Service Commission are appointed by ___ and removed by ___.
x: The Governor appoints State PSC members, but only the President can remove them (Article 317).

q: What is the term of the NHRC chairperson?
x: After the 2019 amendment, the NHRC chairperson holds office for 3 years or until 70, whichever comes first.

q: Which of these states does NOT have a Legislative Council?
x: Six states have a Legislative Council: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra and Karnataka. Odisha has proposed one but it is not yet created.

q: Which amendment gave one-third reservation to women in the Lok Sabha and Assemblies?
x: The 106th Amendment (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023). It starts after the next census and delimitation.

q: Financial Emergency is under which Article, and how many times has it been used?
x: Article 360 is Financial Emergency. It has never been declared. Article 352 = National Emergency, 356 = President's Rule.

q: Who decides whether a bill is a Money Bill?
x: Under Article 110(3) the Lok Sabha Speaker's decision on a Money Bill is final.
